candidates.title: Could Quebec's new government derail plans for Alto's high-speed train project?

candidates.description: The areas affected include... Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm... At 400 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was located over Queens Cove, or over Indrio, moving north at 20 knots. Additional storms will develop near the Treasure Coast and move offshore through late afternoon.

candidates.title: Special Weather Statement issued October 10 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
candidates.description: At 400 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm capable of producing a landspout near Hastings, moving north at 15 mph. HAZARD...Landspouts and wind gusts up to 50 mph. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Locations impacted include... Saint Augustine, Saint Augustine Beach, Crescent Beach, Saint Augustine Shores, Butler Beach, Vilano Beach, Saint Augustine South, Spuds, Anastasia, and Dupont Center.
candidates.author: National Weather Service

candidates.title: Special Marine Warning issued October 10 at 3:59PM EDT until October 10 at 5:30PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
candidates.description: SMWMLB The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a * Special Marine Warning for... Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm... * Until 530 PM EDT. * At 358 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Daytona Beach Shores, or over South Daytona, moving north at 20 knots. Additional storms will develop along the Volusia coast and push offshore through late afternoon. HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater. SOURCE...Radar. IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if possible. * Locations impacted include... Wilbur By The Sea, Big Georges Reef, Daytona Beach Shores, Allandale, and South Daytona.
